StateFlow collection patterns

The recommended way to collect a StateFlow in UI code is repeatOnLifecycle with the STARTED state. This restarts collection when the lifecycle moves and cancels when it stops, which avoids wasting resources while the UI is in the background.

An older alternative is launchWhenStarted, which suspends but does not cancel the collector. Prefer repeatOnLifecycle for new code because it releases upstream resources deterministically and composes well with sharing operators like stateIn.

For one-shot events, SharedFlow with replay zero plus a lifecycle-aware collector remains the standard answer. Remember that StateFlow always replays its latest value to new collectors, so treat it as state, not events.
